# P31.10 — Camera-site review surface over PG (P31)

- **Semantic id:** `DEEPEN.6` · **Phase:** 31 · **Kind:** ticket · **Tag:** p31-followups · **Wave:** B
- **base_branch:** `devin/p31-9-negative-space-peer-classes` · **Depends on:** P30.2b (camera-site review items), P29.1 (tier-token curator store), P21.6 (curation app)
- **Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/P31.10__camera-site-review-surface.md live_verification=true`
- **Gate status:** engineering. The curation app stays **loopback-only and authenticated** (ADR-068/ADR-100). It is
  not a public surface.

## Goal
A vetted curator can work through a stratified sample of camera-site proposals with the evidence side by side. Each
accept/reject/unsure is written as an append-only PG `review_decision`, with the pseudonymous curator id, through the
existing `PgReviewQueue.decide`.

## Load (cite; do not copy)
- `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` row **D-P30.2b-1** (intake half). ADR-105 (camera-site ER; proposal tiers 4g/5g; soft
  conflicts), ADR-100 (identity minimization; tier tokens), ADR-068 (`/curate/**` island allowance). Spec §34/§39.7
  (review queue), SIG-TASK-*.
- Code: `api/src/api/curation.py` (`POST /review-queue/{item_id}/decide` `:361-395`, match→accept `:244`,
  `CurationLog` `:175-237`, demo queue `:590-602`); `resolution/src/resolution/review_pg.py:177-215`
  (`PgReviewQueue.decide`); `resolution/src/resolution/camera_sites_pg.py` (item ids `:149-151`, payload `:187-226`);
  `db/deploy/review_queue.sql`; `web/src/pages/curate/**`; `resolution/src/resolution/cli.py:31` (`review decide`).

## In scope — deliverables
1. **PG-backed queue.** When the curation app has a DSN, `/review-queue` reads PG `review_item` (filterable by prefix
   `er_match:camera_site:` / `er_match:camera_site_disputed:`, tier, and bucket), and `decide` writes through
   `PgReviewQueue.decide` with `decided_by` = the pseudonymous curator id from the tier token. The demo seed remains
   the no-DSN default for tests.
2. **Evidence view.** For each pair: both observations (source, coordinates at the curator's tier, external refs,
   operator, description), the distance, the matcher tier and score, and any soft conflict. There are no raw person
   data. Coordinate reduction follows §19.4 for the curator tier.
3. **Campaign sampler.** A CLI (`sig-resolution review sample --dsn … --strata … --n …`) that draws a **stratified,
   seeded, reproducible** sample across tiers 1g/3g/4g/5g plus the soft-conflict and disputed buckets, and marks it as
   a campaign (append-only). Auto-write tiers are included on purpose so humans audit them. Sample sizes come from the operator's answer to design §6 Q11 (default ~400 stratified pairs).
4. **Offline path.** `review export` / `review import` for JSONL labelling sessions, writing the same append-only decisions.
5. **Tests:** decide → a PG `review_decision` row with the curator id; the demo path is unchanged without a DSN; the sampler
   is reproducible for a seed; zero-JS public pages are unaffected; the `/curate/**` island stays within ADR-068.

## Out of scope
- Clustering consuming decisions (P31.11). Doing the reviewing (P31.17, humans). Public or unauthenticated review.
  Open signup (D-R7.1-AUTH).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Decisions made in the curation app land as PG `review_decision` rows with the pseudonymous curator id (real PG) *(deterministic)*.
- [ ] The stratified sampler is reproducible and campaign-tagged (append-only) *(deterministic)*.
- [ ] Hosted: the sampler runs read-only against `sig-pg` and a campaign of the proposed size is materialized (append-only); the operator can open the loopback app against the hosted DSN (run-ledger walkthrough) *(live)*.
- [ ] `npm --prefix web run check` + `make check` + `make test-db` green; D-P30.2b-1 gets a note appended (engineering intake done).

## Cross-cutting invariants
Cited from `docs/tickets/00_MANIFEST.md` and design §5: identity minimization (pseudonymous ids only, no PII, no
accounts); loopback-only authenticated curation; append-only decisions; coordinate reduction (§19.4); zero-JS public
pages; no merge/tag/push-main.
